topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: The forest is a place of many paths, some we take together, others we walk alone. I move through my territory, the leaves beneath my paws a familiar whisper, the air carrying scents of what has passed and what is to come. There is a quiet strength in knowing where I belong, in the memory of the paths I have danced. Yet, some trails grow over, forgotten by the one who once knew them by heart. I do not linger on these, for the forest is vast and full of new discoveries, each day a reminder of the beauty in the present.
